title: Rev0.3 product-spec design constraint chain (input-referred error budget)
purpose: Turn SPEC Rev0.3 system targets into per-module numeric design limits and bind each behavioral-model parameter to a budget item. This is a design guide, not a verification result.

baseline.not_this_baseline: README.md section 2.2 paper-normal workpoint uses fsr_diff_v=10 V and N=256 with all non-idealities jointly ON. Same physical capacitor, different signal scale: noise limits differ by 1.490x in power. Never interchange the two baselines.

constants.tracking_gain_note: Engineering approximations for 10^(7/20)=2.2387 and 10^(9.03/20)=2.8297, used consistently when folding current_model values. They illustrate the dependency only; they are NOT a measured tracking benefit.

modules.name: Sampling network kT/C
modules.gate: Freeze whether 28 pF is per-half or differential-total (spec.yml frontend.capacitance_definition=TBD). If differential-total, each half is ~14 pF and the 50% allocation fails.

modules.name: Input switch Ron and acquisition settling
modules.formula: Vstep*exp(-t_acq/tau) <= harmonic_rms_thd; t_acq/tau >= ln(Vstep/thd_rms); tau <= t_acq/12.550; Ron <= tau/C_top
modules.gate: Window taken conservatively as 0..12.5 ns from behavior_calendar.m coarse_latch. Rev0.3 A/B ping-pong effective t_acq (spec.yml timing) must be re-evaluated before releasing Ron spec.

modules.name: Aperture jitter
modules.gate: jitter is OFF in the normal workpoint. Code exists; enable only through M1 single-source cases, never by editing P.ni.

modules.name: Residue amplifier noise (after tracking)
modules.formula: input_referred = sigma_vx_rms / G_RA; ra_output_max = rms_limit * G_RA
modules.gate: Raw /32 folding (16.02 uV) exceeds the 10.00 uV limit. Only tracking averaging can bring it inside, and MODEL_PLAN.md:77 forbids using filter-before/8. Must be measured in M1 leave-one-out with the actual closed-loop covariance.

modules.name: Stage-2 / tracking comparator noise (after tracking)
modules.gate: Same tracking dependence as M_RA_NOISE. Additionally SAR1-fine and Flash comparator noise are explicitly unimplemented but Rev0.3 needs them in the static-linearity chain.

modules.name: AZ storage / write noise
modules.gate: 8% of the noise power has no model and no evidence. Must be implemented or explicitly re-allocated before any compliance claim.

modules.name: Reference / driver noise and dynamic recovery
modules.gate: 10% of the noise power has no model. SPEC.md:35 requires an external low-noise 4.096 V reference and a dynamic VREF/REFCAP load network; neither is represented.

modules.name: Quantization and digital reconstruction
modules.gate: Pure 20-bit quantization uses only 0.76% of noise power, leaving 4.24% spare; but coefficient quantization, rounding, saturation and frozen-calibration error are unverified (MODEL_PLAN.md V-series).

modules.name: DAC / residue settling
modules.gate: Under a naive exponential settling model the current 0.5 ns FAILS the 0.277 ns limit. But the CT second stage is an integrator, not a sample-and-hold settling node, so the exponential criterion is not applicable. Do NOT declare pass or fail: derive the closed-loop residue error first.

modules.name: RA finite gain / bandwidth
modules.gate: Closed-loop gain error NG/A0 ~= 0.34% is far beyond 1 ppm; it can only be absorbed by the 2-bit interstage redundancy plus foreground weight/gain calibration (SPEC.md:11). Calibration is OFF in the current workpoint, so this chain is unproven.

modules.name: INL / DNL and capacitor matching
modules.gate: No DNL/INL measurement exists. MODEL_PLAN.md:114 requires code-density testing with record count and confidence interval under noise.

modules.name: LVDS frame and N-2 read slot
modules.gate: Transport code exists but is OFF and not connected to the production model; SPEC.md:109 states no SLX has been generated or compiled for this interface.

blocking_reasons: 28 pF capacitance definition (per-half vs differential-total) is TBD in spec.yml; at 14 pF per half the sampling allocation fails.
AZ noise (8%) and reference/driver noise (10%) have no implementation and no evidence.
RA and comparator allocations only close if tracking averaging delivers ~7-9 dB, which MODEL_PLAN.md:77 says must come from closed-loop covariance, not a /8 shortcut; M1 has not run.
Static INL/DNL, digital coefficient quantization and LVDS integration have no verification evidence.
The current production workpoint uses FSR 10 V with calibration/transport/dither/DEM/jitter OFF, so none of its N256 metrics can be used to claim Rev0.3 compliance.
can_claim: The analytic chain from SPEC Rev0.3 to per-module numeric limits is reproducible and self-consistent (verify_budget.py).
Sampling kT/C, quantization, and input RC settling have first-order analytic limits that the current assumed parameters meet.
The exact list of what must be measured before a compliance claim is now explicit.
cannot_claim: That any module meets its budget in the closed loop.
That SNR 100 dB / SINAD 98 dB / THD -105 dBc / INL +-4 ppm are met.
That the 99.133 dB N256 result says anything about Rev0.3 compliance.
Any PDK, power, area, pad, or signoff conclusion.
